---
name: Technical critique
about: Challenge a claim, assumption, proof boundary, or design decision
title: "[Critique] "
labels: critique
assignees: ""
---

## Claim or section

Quote or link the exact claim being challenged.

## Failure mechanism or contrary evidence

Describe the counterexample, missing resource, unsound inference, or stronger prior art. Link primary sources when available.

## Consequence

Does this invalidate the architecture, narrow its service envelope, require a different model contract, or only change implementation details?

## Smallest decisive test

What experiment, proof obligation, or measurement would resolve this?

## Possible repair

Optional. If the claim can be repaired without moving the goalposts, explain how.
